Useful for anyone weighing a move from Cursor to Codex.

item.title: [infoq] 从“单目感知”到“多视角立体对齐”：PrismAlign 重新定义文档结构化提取的精度上限
item.description: PrismAlign, a Huawei paper accepted to EMNLP Industry Track 2026, runs several VLM views over the same document layout and reconciles their outputs with a Bayesian decision layer to curb table-OCR hallucinations. It targets systematic failures such as invented cells, flattened multi-level headers and misread punctuation in nested, rotated or gridline-free tables, and is aimed at teams building document extraction pipelines.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] Opus 5.5 为我搭建了一套 2D MMORPG 音乐美术管线
item.description: A V2EX user built a full music and art pipeline for a 2D MMORPG with Claude Code and Opus 5.5, with the result running at m.linsenx.com. No image or music generation models were used at any point, so the assets come from a code-driven workflow instead — useful for developers probing how far coding agents can go.

item.title: [infoq] 29 小时攻破浏览器，GPT-6 Astra 成为 OpenAI 首个“严重级”模型
item.description: OpenAI rated GPT-6 Astra's cybersecurity capability as "severe" under its Preparedness Framework, the first model to cross that threshold, and Microsoft said the same day that it is available in Foundry Models. In expert-supervised tests, Astra built a browser sandbox-escape chain in 29 hours, adapted it to the official stable build in 12 more, and produced a working kernel local privilege escalation in 12 hours.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 分享一个自用的 V2EX 样式，参考 macOS / Safari 风格
item.description: A pure-CSS theme for V2EX styled after macOS / Safari that adjusts fonts, colors and spacing and supports light and dark modes following V2EX's own toggle. Installing it means pasting a single jsdelivr @import line into V2EX's custom CSS settings; the version is pinned at v1.0.0 and no browser extension is needed.

item.title: [infoq] WSO2 发布 Agent Manager，企业寻求应对日益严重的 AI Agent 泛滥问题
item.description: WSO2 has released Agent Manager, separating agent governance from agent logic so enterprises can apply uniform controls regardless of the underlying model, framework, or runtime. It offers verifiable agent identities, RBAC, delegation and revocation, 40-plus built-in controls such as PII redaction and rate limiting, plus MCP governance and a Kubernetes-native sandbox runtime. It entered beta in June 2026 and supports LangChain, CrewAI, Bedrock and similar stacks.

item.title: [v2ex] [推广] 打破圈壁！为什么说 Bybit 是每个数字游民与全球资产配置者的“生态位终点站”？ Bybit 已支持链上美股， Bybit U 卡支持微信、支付宝、Apple Pay 三 通啦！
item.description: A promotional Bybit post whose pitches are a Mastercard-branded Bybit Card that can be linked to Alipay, WeChat Pay and similar channels to spend USDT/USDC, an integration with MetaTrader 5 for forex, gold and global index trading, and new-user rewards such as 10U for a 100U deposit. It targets people with cross-border spending or global allocation needs, but it is marketing copy with signup bonuses, so reward thresholds and card-region limits should be checked.

item.title: [infoq] 利用 AI 搭建内部开发者平台
item.description: Speaking at KubeCon Europe, Whitney Lee and Viktor Farcic argued that agents are becoming the new internal developer platform, replacing tools like Backstage: an agent takes a developer's request, enriches it with context pulled via semantic search over Git repos, Slack threads, Jira tickets and Zoom recordings, then passes it to an LLM that either answers or calls tools. Farcic stressed guardrails to block or approve agent actions, and using OpenTelemetry's GenAI semantic conventions to capture

item.title: [infoq] 60 万行巨石应用 AI 重构的可验证交付工程｜QCon上海
item.description: At QCon Shanghai on October 22–24, Ant Group engineer Jiang Yu will present "Verifiable Delivery Engineering for AI Refactoring of a 600k-Line Monolith," drawn from Alipay's life-bill payment system: about 600,000 lines of Java and over 600 interfaces rewritten across languages. Rather than migrating code, the project migrates behavior — PERS modeling and Case-Forge generate scenarios, and Bubble replays them to verify behavioral differences and support staged traffic cutover.

item.title: [infoq] 云栖之后，10+阿里AI实战派将亮相QCon上海站
item.description: QCon Shanghai runs October 22-24 with more than ten engineers from Alibaba, Fliggy, Taotian, the Qwen team and AliExpress on stage. Fliggy CTO Chen Ye's keynote traces why AI moves from coding to agents to consumption, while Alibaba's Yang Linfeng covers an agent loop that automates operator tuning for MaaS inference, cutting the cycle from weeks to days. Aimed at engineers working on taking AI from demo to production scale.

item.description: A Juejin article tackles the interview question "AI can already write 80% of the code, so why does the company still need you?" It contrasts 2026 interviews with those two years ago, when candidates hand-wrote a Promise or explained React Fiber internals; today interviewers assume AI use and probe something else. Useful for developers preparing for interviews or doing the hiring, though the supplied excerpt cuts off before the full argument.

item.title: [infoq] GPT-6猛砍价，Opus 5.5忙“变好用”：模型价格战，已经不能只看API定价
item.description: On September 23, OpenAI and Anthropic shipped new models roughly an hour apart: GPT-6 Sol for professional work, coding and complex agent tasks, the cheaper GPT-6 Luna, and Claude Opus 5.5, which adds Communication as an upgrade focus. Sol's API input price fell from $4 to $2 per million tokens and output from $20 to $10, with Luna halved again — the race is shifting from token prices to the cost of completing a task.

item.title: [infoq] 世界人工智能开源大赛（GOAI）总决赛暨颁奖盛典在杭州举行
item.description: The GOAI open-source AI competition held its finals in Hangzhou on September 22-23, drawing over 14,000 developers from 91 countries and 2,999 valid first-round entries, with 70 projects reaching the final round. Four tracks covered agent infrastructure, industry applications, AI for research and embodied intelligence, with six champion teams competing for the grand prize. Judging weighted real-world problem value, verifiability and open-source reuse over demos.

item.title: [infoq] 数据、模型、算力越来越难分开，Data+AI 基础设施怎么进化？
item.description: At Yunqi, Alibaba Cloud detailed upgrades to its MaxCompute AI compute engine, which now schedules CPU, GPU and LLM token calls together and lets Python and SQL jobs call AI directly through MaxFrame and SQL AI Functions. The driver: in embodied AI and similar workloads, producing training data itself burns CPU, GPU, storage and tokens, and one data pipeline can take two weeks or longer. Relevant to teams building data-plus-AI infrastructure.

It works on Chrome and other Chromium browsers, and the extension has to be sideloaded in develo

It ships a Python package (hindsight-api), an npm client, docs, a cookbook, a benchmark site and an arXiv paper (2512.12818), plus a hosted Hindsight Cloud. Developers who want a persistent memory layer for agents without building one from scratch can check its benchmarks first.

item.description: WallpaperMachine is an open-source native macOS wallpaper engine that renders Scene, Video and Web wallpapers and ships a built-in Steam Workshop browser, though downloading requires a Steam account that owns Wallpaper Engine. It pairs a Swift/AppKit shell with a Rust rendering core, supports per-display settings and audio reactivity, and needs macOS 26 Tahoe on Apple Silicon; signed builds aren't out yet, so you compile it yourself.

item.description: A technical write-up describes how the German Army Enigma message MVUEH of 10 July 1941, logged as Nr. 172 by the SS-Totenkopf quartermaster, was finally broken: Carter Leffen sent the key and plaintext to the author for validation, and the headline credits OpenAI GPT–6 Astra. The message had resisted every attempt since 2005, and Alex Shovkoplyas's 2017 break of the same day's SIPVX message recovered a key that didn't fit here. Of interest to Enigma historians and anyone weighing LLM reasoning

It diagnoses those failures and walks through an engineering-oriented fix, aimed at developers doing long-form generation with LLMs.

It combines AI-powered routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, and a self-evolving knowledge base with Claude Code support—aimed at developers who use AI coding assistants in security work.

item.title: [github_trending] block/buzz
item.description: Buzz is block's open-source, self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms. A community is the workspace a user reaches by URL; in the single-relay setup shipping today one relay URL maps to exactly one community, though a hosted operator can serve many communities across domains or subdomains. It is Apache 2.0 licensed and suits teams that want agents inside their chat while keeping the relay under their own control.

item.description: NVIDIA has open-sourced Model Optimizer (ModelOpt), a single library bundling quantization, pruning, NAS, distillation, speculative decoding and sparsity, with Hugging Face, PyTorch and ONNX inputs under an Apache 2.0 license.
